  "chapters": [
    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "The Critical Failure of Dying",
      "goal": "Introduce Arthur and his accidental 'Glass Cannon' Isekai transition where every hit he lands is a crit, but he has exactly 1 HP.",
      "chapter_role": "hook",
      "stakes_shift": "From mundane debt-ridden life to a high-stakes survival game where a stubbed toe means permadeath.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Arthur's final moments in the real world during a freak electrical accident.",
        "to_next": "Arthur stands at the entrance of the 'Newbie Slums' with a glowing red warning over his head."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 4,
        "tempo": "rush",
        "expected_scene_count": 10
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Short-Circuit",
          "intent": "Establish Arthur's mundane life and the freak accident that triggers his transition.",
          "end_condition": "Arthur's consciousness fades in the real world amidst electrical sparks.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Arthur struggles with his mounting debt and a broken coffee machine in his cramped apartment.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Arthur decides to fix the faulty wiring himself to save money.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR"],
              "location_start_label": "Arthur's Apartment",
              "location_end_label": "Arthur's Kitchen",
              "location_start": "A cluttered one-room studio apartment smelling of old laundry.",
              "location_end": "A narrow kitchen corner with exposed wires behind the counter.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Arthur stares at the red 'Past Due' notice on his kitchen table.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The unpaid electric bill", "The flickering overhead light", "Arthur's worn-out screwdriver"],
              "transition_out_text": "He reaches for the sparking outlet with a pair of uninsulated pliers.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The exposed copper wire", "A puddle of spilled water", "Arthur's sweaty palms"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "The wiring explodes, sending a massive surge through Arthur as he tries to fix the outlet.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Arthur's heart stops as the world turns into white light.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR"],
              "location_start_label": "Arthur's Kitchen",
              "location_end_label": "The Void",
              "location_start": "The kitchen corner, now smelling of ozone and burnt plastic.",
              "location_end": "A pitch-black expanse where gravity doesn't exist.",
              "handoff_mode": "hard_cut",
              "constraint_state": "processed",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "transition_in_text": "The pliers make contact, and the world screams in high-voltage static.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The blue electrical arc", "The smell of ozone", "The sudden silence"],
              "transition_out_text": "Darkness swallows the sparks, leaving Arthur floating in nothingness.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The fading hum of electricity", "The lack of weight", "Arthur's vanishing pulse"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:3",
              "end_condition_echo": "Arthur's consciousness fades in the real world amidst electrical sparks."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Glitched Awakening",
          "intent": "Arthur wakes in the system and discovers his impossible 1 HP / 100% Crit Rate status.",
          "end_condition": "Arthur confirms the 'Glass Cannon' status is not a temporary UI bug.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Arthur wakes up in a glowing blue chamber and hears the System's welcome message.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "Arthur realizes he has been 'reallocated' to a game world.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR", "CHAR_SYSTEM"],
              "location_start_label": "The Void",
              "location_end_label": "The Reallocation Chamber",
              "location_start": "The pitch-black expanse.",
              "location_end": "A sterile, hexagonal room pulsing with blue light.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "transition_in_text": "A chime rings in his ears, louder than the heart attack he just had.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The floating text box", "The hum of the chamber", "Arthur's translucent hands"],
              "transition_out_text": "The System begins to display his character sheet.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The loading bar", "The 'Welcome User' prompt", "Arthur's confusion"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:4"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Arthur inspects his stats and finds a massive error in his health and critical hit chance.",
              "type": "investigation",
              "outcome": "Arthur discovers his HP is locked at 1, but his Crit Rate is 100%.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR"],
              "location_start_label": "The Reallocation Chamber",
              "location_end_label": "The Reallocation Chamber",
              "location_start": "The sterile, hexagonal room.",
              "location_end": "The center of the chamber where a HUD floats in the air.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "transition_in_text": "Arthur swipes at the air, trying to find the 'Save and Exit' button.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The red HP bar", "The gold Crit Rate icon", "The 'Error' tag"],
              "transition_out_text": "He tries to refresh the screen, but the numbers remain stubbornly fixed.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The digit '1'", "The percentage '100%'", "Arthur's trembling finger"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Arthur tries to allocate points to Constitution, but the System rejects the input.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Arthur learns that his status is 'Immutable' due to a transition error.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR", "CHAR_SYSTEM"],
              "location_start_label": "The Reallocation Chamber",
              "location_end_label": "The Reallocation Chamber",
              "location_start": "The center of the chamber.",
              "location_end": "The exit portal of the chamber.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "transition_in_text": "He mashes the '+' icon next to Constitution like a maniac.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The 'Invalid Action' beep", "The red text warning", "Arthur's growing panic"],
              "transition_out_text": "The door to the world slides open, forcing him forward.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The blinding white exit", "The rush of air", "Arthur's thin tunic"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Arthur tests his 1 HP by poking a sharp rock and nearly dying from the scratch.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Arthur confirms that any damage at all will result in immediate death.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR"],
              "location_start_label": "The Reallocation Chamber",
              "location_end_label": "The Threshold",
              "location_start": "The exit portal.",
              "location_end": "A rocky ledge overlooking a vast, digital landscape.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "transition_in_text": "He steps out onto the dirt, his feet feeling every pebble.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["A jagged obsidian rock", "Arthur's bare heel", "The flashing red HP bar"],
              "transition_out_text": "He pulls his foot back, realizing a papercut is a lethal weapon.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The single drop of blood", "The 'Critical Health' siren", "Arthur's wide eyes"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:7",
              "end_condition_echo": "Arthur confirms the 'Glass Cannon' status is not a temporary UI bug."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Slumming It",
          "intent": "Arthur arrives at the Newbie Slums and realizes the immediate danger of his environment.",
          "end_condition": "Arthur stands at the entrance of the Newbie Slums with a glowing red warning over his head.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "Arthur descends the mountain path toward the first settlement, avoiding every loose stone.",
              "type": "travel",
              "outcome": "Arthur reaches the outskirts of the Newbie Slums.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR"],
              "location_start_label": "The Threshold",
              "location_end_label": "The Slum Outskirts",
              "location_start": "The rocky ledge.",
              "location_end": "A dusty road lined with dilapidated shacks.",
              "handoff_mode": "montage",
              "constraint_state": "fleeing",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "transition_in_text": "He moves like he's walking on eggshells, eyes glued to the ground.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The steep cliffside", "The loose gravel", "Arthur's hyper-focus"],
              "transition_out_text": "The first signs of civilization appear, and they look miserable.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The rotting wood fence", "The smell of sewage", "The distant shouting"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:8"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "The System informs Arthur that his 1 HP status has triggered a 'High Risk' bounty on his head.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "Arthur realizes that being fragile makes him a target for 'Griefers'.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR", "CHAR_SYSTEM"],
              "location_start_label": "The Slum Outskirts",
              "location_end_label": "The Slum Outskirts",
              "location_start": "The dusty road.",
              "location_end": "A shadow beneath a large, rusted pipe.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "pursued",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "transition_in_text": "A new notification pops up, glowing a violent shade of crimson.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The 'Bounty Active' sign", "The skull icon", "Arthur's dry throat"],
              "transition_out_text": "He ducks behind a pipe as a group of players walks by.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The heavy iron pipe", "The sound of clanking armor", "Arthur's bated breath"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:9"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "summary": "Arthur watches a level 1 player get knocked over by a stray dog and instantly respawn.",
              "type": "investigation",
              "outcome": "Arthur realizes the world is chaotic and his margin for error is zero.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR"],
              "location_start_label": "The Slum Outskirts",
              "location_end_label": "The Slum Entrance",
              "location_start": "The shadow beneath the pipe.",
              "location_end": "The main gate of the Newbie Slums.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:8",
              "transition_in_text": "A yelp draws his attention to the middle of the road.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The mangy street dog", "The dissolving blue pixels", "Arthur's grimace"],
              "transition_out_text": "He edges toward the gate, his heart hammering against his ribs.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The iron-bound gate", "The crowd of beggars", "Arthur's slow steps"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:10"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 10,
              "summary": "Arthur reaches the gate, and a massive red arrow appears above him, signaling his vulnerability.",
              "type": "climax",
              "outcome": "Arthur is officially marked as the easiest kill in the zone.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR"],
              "location_start_label": "The Slum Entrance",
              "location_end_label": "The Newbie Slums",
              "location_start": "The main gate.",
              "location_end": "The muddy main street of the Slums.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "pursued",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:9",
              "transition_in_text": "He crosses the threshold, and a spotlight of red light hits him.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The glowing red arrow", "The 'EASY XP' tag", "The turning heads"],
              "transition_out_text": "Every eye in the street fixes on him, and the hunt begins.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The predatory grins", "The unsheathed daggers", "Arthur's frozen stance"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:1",
              "end_condition_echo": "Arthur stands at the entrance of the Newbie Slums with a glowing red warning over his head."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 2,
      "title": "Tutorials are for People with HP",
      "goal": "Arthur must clear the basic combat tutorial without taking a single point of environmental or monster damage.",
      "chapter_role": "setup",
      "stakes_shift": "Arthur realizes he can't play the game normally and must find 'exploits' in movement and stealth to survive.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Arthur enters the tutorial zone with his 1 HP handicap.",
        "to_next": "Arthur discovers a hidden vendor who sells items that shouldn't be available to level 1s."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 3,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 10
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Zero-Tolerance Zone",
          "intent": "Arthur enters the tutorial and learns the movement mechanics required to avoid all damage.",
          "end_condition": "Arthur reaches the first combat trial without losing his 1 HP.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Arthur sprints away from the initial crowd and dives into the Tutorial Instance portal.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Arthur escapes the griefers and enters a private instance.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR"],
              "location_start_label": "The Newbie Slums",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Lobby",
              "location_start": "The muddy main street.",
              "location_end": "A quiet, white-walled corridor.",
              "handoff_mode": "hard_cut",
              "constraint_state": "fleeing",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:10",
              "transition_in_text": "He doesn't wait for a greeting; he just runs.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The blue portal swirl", "The sound of chasing boots", "Arthur's heavy breathing"],
              "transition_out_text": "The noise of the slums vanishes, replaced by a soft, melodic chime.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The white marble floor", "The floating 'Tutorial' sign", "Arthur's safe landing"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Arthur practices the 'Dash' and 'Slide' mechanics, realizing he can use them to clip through hitboxes.",
              "type": "investigation",
              "outcome": "Arthur develops a movement style based on frame-perfect evasion.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Lobby",
              "location_end_label": "Practice Range",
              "location_start": "The white corridor.",
              "location_end": "A room filled with swinging wooden beams.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:1",
              "transition_in_text": "He sees a dummy beam swinging and realizes he can't just block it.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The wooden pendulum", "The green 'Dash' stamina bar", "Arthur's focused gaze"],
              "transition_out_text": "He slides under the beam, his nose inches from the splintered wood.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The floor's friction", "The 'Perfect Dodge' notification", "Arthur's smirk"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Arthur navigates a field of floor-spikes that pop up at random intervals.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Arthur learns to read the System's 'pre-attack' tells.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR"],
              "location_start_label": "Practice Range",
              "location_end_label": "Trial Gate",
              "location_start": "The room with swinging beams.",
              "location_end": "The entrance to the first combat arena.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "transition_in_text": "The floor tiles begin to vibrate, a fraction of a second before the steel rises.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The dust rising from floor cracks", "The metallic 'clack'", "Arthur's rhythmic jumping"],
              "transition_out_text": "He reaches the far door, his 1 HP still intact and his heart rate finally slowing.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The heavy brass handle", "The 'Section Complete' banner", "Arthur's steady hand"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "Arthur reaches the first combat trial without losing his 1 HP."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "Precision Violence",
          "intent": "Arthur uses his 100% crit rate to one-shot tutorial mobs before they can react.",
          "end_condition": "The combat trial is cleared with a 'Flawless' rating.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "The first tutorial mob, a 'Slime-ling', spawns in the center of the arena.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Arthur prepares to test his 100% Crit Rate for the first time.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR"],
              "location_start_label": "Trial Gate",
              "location_end_label": "Combat Arena",
              "location_start": "The heavy brass handle.",
              "location_end": "A circular pit with high stone walls.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:3",
              "transition_in_text": "He steps into the pit, and a pile of green goo coalesces in front of him.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The Slime-ling's gurgle", "Arthur's rusty starter dagger", "The 'Fight!' prompt"],
              "transition_out_text": "He circles the creature, looking for the tiny 'Core' hitbox.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The pulsing red core", "The slime's trail", "Arthur's calculated orbit"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Arthur strikes the slime's core, triggering a massive 'CRITICAL' explosion.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The slime is vaporized instantly, dealing 10,000% overkill damage.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR"],
              "location_start_label": "Combat Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Combat Arena",
              "location_start": "The circular pit.",
              "location_end": "The center of the arena, covered in green residue.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:4",
              "transition_in_text": "He lunges, the dagger point meeting the core with a sound like breaking glass.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The golden 'CRITICAL' text", "The slime's violent pop", "The floating damage numbers"],
              "transition_out_text": "The overkill is so high the System lags for a microsecond.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The frozen frame", "The green mist", "Arthur's wide grin"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "A wave of five 'Training Drones' enters the arena, firing slow-moving energy bolts.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Arthur uses his mobility to thread the needle and one-shot all five drones.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR"],
              "location_start_label": "Combat Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Combat Arena",
              "location_start": "The center of the arena.",
              "location_end": "The arena walls, where Arthur is wall-running.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:5",
              "transition_in_text": "The ceiling panels slide back, and the drones descend on humming fans.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The blue energy projectiles", "The wall-run trail", "Arthur's rapid strikes"],
              "transition_out_text": "Five 'CRITICAL' pop-ups appear in a perfect line as the drones fall.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The falling scrap metal", "The '5x Multiplier' icon", "Arthur's landing"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "The arena clears, and the System displays a 'Flawless' rating with a special reward chest.",
              "type": "reward",
              "outcome": "Arthur receives a 'Flawless Tutorial' token and a massive XP boost.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR", "CHAR_SYSTEM"],
              "location_start_label": "Combat Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Arena Exit",
              "location_start": "The arena floor.",
              "location_end": "A secret alcove that opens in the wall.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:6",
              "transition_in_text": "The 'Flawless' banner fills his vision, shining with an annoying gold light.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The 'S' Rank icon", "The ornate chest", "The token's glow"],
              "transition_out_text": "He grabs the token and notices a small, glitchy-looking door behind the chest.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The flickering door frame", "The lack of a label", "Arthur's curiosity"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:8",
              "end_condition_echo": "The combat trial is cleared with a 'Flawless' rating."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "The Secret Shop",
          "intent": "Arthur finds a hidden vendor exploit before leaving the tutorial zone.",
          "end_condition": "Arthur discovers a hidden vendor who sells items that shouldn't be available to level 1s.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Arthur enters the glitchy door and finds himself in a room that looks like the back-end of the game.",
              "type": "investigation",
              "outcome": "Arthur discovers a 'Developer's Closet' hidden in the tutorial.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR"],
              "location_start_label": "Arena Exit",
              "location_end_label": "The Developer's Closet",
              "location_start": "The secret alcove.",
              "location_end": "A room filled with untextured white cubes and floating code.",
              "handoff_mode": "hard_cut",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:7",
              "transition_in_text": "He steps through the flickering frame and the graphics drop to low-poly.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["The wireframe floor", "The floating 'ERROR_404' signs", "Arthur's blocky shadow"],
              "transition_out_text": "In the corner, sitting on a crate, is a NPC that shouldn't be here.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The NPC's hooded cloak", "The '???' name tag", "The smell of old parchment"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:9"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "summary": "Silas the Shady offers Arthur items in exchange for the 'Flawless Token'.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "Arthur learns that Silas sells 'unbalanced' items the developers forgot to delete.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTHUR", "CHAR_SILAS"],
              "location_start_label": "The Developer's Closet",
              "location_end_label": "The Developer's Closet",
              "location_start": "The wireframe room.",
              "location_end": "Silas's makeshift counter.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:8",
              "transition_in_text": "The NPC looks up, his eyes glowing with a faint blue light.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["Silas's crooked grin", "The 'Trade' window", "Arthur's Flawless Token"],
              "transition_out_text": "Arthur browses the inventory and finds something that makes his heart skip.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["The 'Cloak of the Untouchable'", "The price tag", "Silas's raspy laugh"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:10"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 10,
              "summary": "Arthur buys a rare item and prepares to leave the tutorial zone with a massive advantage.",
              "type": "reward",
